topic: Smart Beta, Quant Funds and other Non-Traditional Index Funds
source_evidence: In addition, these funds may have limited performance histories. It may not be clear how they will perform under different market conditions.
question: Misconception: Because a non-traditional index fund is an index fund, it must be easy to understand and have a long track record across different market conditions.
answer: Correction: Non-traditional index funds can use complex strategies, and some have limited performance histories. Their past records may not show how they will perform under different market conditions.
